target.title: Real-time AI enabled rail track inspection and analysis [RAPPID] - Resilience Fund Application
target.abstract: RAPPID uses AI, deep learning and phased-array ultrasonic testing hardware to support real-time rail track defect inspection and analysis. It addresses Network Rail infrastructure inspection constraints and predictive maintenance needs across the UK network.
